# Matcha powder

<section class="hmi-quick-read" id="matcha-powder-quick-read" data-hmi-quick-read aria-labelledby="matcha-powder-quick-read-label"><div class="hmi-quick-read-label" id="matcha-powder-quick-read-label">Quick read</div>

Matcha powder in the HMI library has 385 reported results for lead, cadmium, total arsenic, total mercury, nickel, chromium, aluminium, tin, uranium, Co, Cu, Fe, Mn, Zn, Se, Ag, Ba, Be, Ca, Ce, Cs, Ga, Ho, K, Li, Mg, Na, P, Sr, Ta, Ti and Tl from 2 sources.<sup class="cite">[[sources/thai2026-matcha-powder-thailand-metals|1]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">ด้วยเศียรเกล้า รัสริณทร์, บำรุงพืชน์ เอกราช · 2026</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/thai2026-matcha-powder-thailand-metals">Determination of heavy metal contents in commercial matcha powder sold in Thailand (Thai: ปริมาณสารโลหะหนักตกค้างในผลิตภัณฑ์ผงมัทฉะที่จำหน่ายในประเทศไทย)</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Journal of Environmental Education Medical and Health (Thailand), Vol. 11 No. 2, April-July 2026, pp. 1204-1212</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/thai2026-matcha-powder-thailand-metals">Read source →</a></span></span></sup><sup class="cite">[[sources/kolackova2020-matcha-minerals-trace-elements|2]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Koláčková T, Sumczynski D, Zálešáková L, Šenkárová L, Orsavová J, Lanczová N · 2020</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/kolackova2020-matcha-minerals-trace-elements">Free and bound amino acids, minerals and trace elements in matcha (Camellia sinensis L.): A nutritional evaluation</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Journal of Food Composition and Analysis (2020), article 103581 (Journal Pre-proof)</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/kolackova2020-matcha-minerals-trace-elements">Read source →</a></span></span></sup>

<ul>
<li>
<strong>Metals measured:</strong>

Lead, cadmium, total arsenic, total mercury, nickel and chromium and others, in 385 results from 2 sources.<sup class="cite">[[sources/thai2026-matcha-powder-thailand-metals|1]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">ด้วยเศียรเกล้า รัสริณทร์, บำรุงพืชน์ เอกราช · 2026</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/thai2026-matcha-powder-thailand-metals">Determination of heavy metal contents in commercial matcha powder sold in Thailand (Thai: ปริมาณสารโลหะหนักตกค้างในผลิตภัณฑ์ผงมัทฉะที่จำหน่ายในประเทศไทย)</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Journal of Environmental Education Medical and Health (Thailand), Vol. 11 No. 2, April-July 2026, pp. 1204-1212</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/thai2026-matcha-powder-thailand-metals">Read source →</a></span></span></sup><sup class="cite">[[sources/kolackova2020-matcha-minerals-trace-elements|2]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Koláčková T, Sumczynski D, Zálešáková L, Šenkárová L, Orsavová J, Lanczová N · 2020</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/kolackova2020-matcha-minerals-trace-elements">Free and bound amino acids, minerals and trace elements in matcha (Camellia sinensis L.): A nutritional evaluation</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Journal of Food Composition and Analysis (2020), article 103581 (Journal Pre-proof)</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/kolackova2020-matcha-minerals-trace-elements">Read source →</a></span></span></sup>

</li>
<li>
<strong>Main drivers:</strong>

Form, basis and where the matcha powder was sampled; reporting limits decide how many results are non-detects.<sup class="cite">[[sources/thai2026-matcha-powder-thailand-metals|1]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">ด้วยเศียรเกล้า รัสริณทร์, บำรุงพืชน์ เอกราช · 2026</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/thai2026-matcha-powder-thailand-metals">Determination of heavy metal contents in commercial matcha powder sold in Thailand (Thai: ปริมาณสารโลหะหนักตกค้างในผลิตภัณฑ์ผงมัทฉะที่จำหน่ายในประเทศไทย)</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Journal of Environmental Education Medical and Health (Thailand), Vol. 11 No. 2, April-July 2026, pp. 1204-1212</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/thai2026-matcha-powder-thailand-metals">Read source →</a></span></span></sup><sup class="cite">[[sources/kolackova2020-matcha-minerals-trace-elements|2]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Koláčková T, Sumczynski D, Zálešáková L, Šenkárová L, Orsavová J, Lanczová N · 2020</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/kolackova2020-matcha-minerals-trace-elements">Free and bound amino acids, minerals and trace elements in matcha (Camellia sinensis L.): A nutritional evaluation</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Journal of Food Composition and Analysis (2020), article 103581 (Journal Pre-proof)</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/kolackova2020-matcha-minerals-trace-elements">Read source →</a></span></span></sup>

</li>
<li>
<strong>Practical framing:</strong>

Ask for lot results with a quantification limit well below the limit that applies in the destination market.<sup class="cite">[[sources/thai2026-matcha-powder-thailand-metals|1]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">ด้วยเศียรเกล้า รัสริณทร์, บำรุงพืชน์ เอกราช · 2026</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/thai2026-matcha-powder-thailand-metals">Determination of heavy metal contents in commercial matcha powder sold in Thailand (Thai: ปริมาณสารโลหะหนักตกค้างในผลิตภัณฑ์ผงมัทฉะที่จำหน่ายในประเทศไทย)</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Journal of Environmental Education Medical and Health (Thailand), Vol. 11 No. 2, April-July 2026, pp. 1204-1212</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/thai2026-matcha-powder-thailand-metals">Read source →</a></span></span></sup><sup class="cite">[[sources/kolackova2020-matcha-minerals-trace-elements|2]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Koláčková T, Sumczynski D, Zálešáková L, Šenkárová L, Orsavová J, Lanczová N · 2020</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/kolackova2020-matcha-minerals-trace-elements">Free and bound amino acids, minerals and trace elements in matcha (Camellia sinensis L.): A nutritional evaluation</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Journal of Food Composition and Analysis (2020), article 103581 (Journal Pre-proof)</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/kolackova2020-matcha-minerals-trace-elements">Read source →</a></span></span></sup>

</li>
</ul>

<a id="overview"></a>
<a id="decision-summary"></a>
## Matcha powder overview

<a id="hmi-ing-004"></a>
<a id="which-contamination-concerns-are-supported-for-this-ingredient-and-its-defined-forms"></a>
<a id="hmi-ing-005"></a>
<a id="which-sourcing-or-production-decisions-deserve-priority-on-the-available-evidence"></a>
<a id="hmi-ing-006"></a>
<a id="which-evidence-gaps-most-limit-those-decisions"></a>

Matcha powder in the HMI library has 385 reported results for lead, cadmium, total arsenic, total mercury, nickel, chromium, aluminium, tin, uranium, Co, Cu, Fe, Mn, Zn, Se, Ag, Ba, Be, Ca, Ce, Cs, Ga, Ho, K, Li, Mg, Na, P, Sr, Ta, Ti and Tl from 2 sources.<sup class="cite">[[sources/thai2026-matcha-powder-thailand-metals|1]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">ด้วยเศียรเกล้า รัสริณทร์, บำรุงพืชน์ เอกราช · 2026</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/thai2026-matcha-powder-thailand-metals">Determination of heavy metal contents in commercial matcha powder sold in Thailand (Thai: ปริมาณสารโลหะหนักตกค้างในผลิตภัณฑ์ผงมัทฉะที่จำหน่ายในประเทศไทย)</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Journal of Environmental Education Medical and Health (Thailand), Vol. 11 No. 2, April-July 2026, pp. 1204-1212</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/thai2026-matcha-powder-thailand-metals">Read source →</a></span></span></sup><sup class="cite">[[sources/kolackova2020-matcha-minerals-trace-elements|2]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Koláčková T, Sumczynski D, Zálešáková L, Šenkárová L, Orsavová J, Lanczová N · 2020</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/kolackova2020-matcha-minerals-trace-elements">Free and bound amino acids, minerals and trace elements in matcha (Camellia sinensis L.): A nutritional evaluation</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Journal of Food Composition and Analysis (2020), article 103581 (Journal Pre-proof)</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/kolackova2020-matcha-minerals-trace-elements">Read source →</a></span></span></sup>

รัสริณทร์ et al. 2026 reported lead at 404 µg/kg (mean ± 267 SD), cadmium at 30.6 µg/kg (mean ± 25 SD), total arsenic at 43.1 µg/kg (mean ± 49.2 SD) and total mercury at 11.7 µg/kg (mean ± 4.93 SD) in matcha powder, powder or ground from all 12 retail products, Thailand.<sup class="cite">[[sources/thai2026-matcha-powder-thailand-metals|1]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">ด้วยเศียรเกล้า รัสริณทร์, บำรุงพืชน์ เอกราช · 2026</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/thai2026-matcha-powder-thailand-metals">Determination of heavy metal contents in commercial matcha powder sold in Thailand (Thai: ปริมาณสารโลหะหนักตกค้างในผลิตภัณฑ์ผงมัทฉะที่จำหน่ายในประเทศไทย)</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Journal of Environmental Education Medical and Health (Thailand), Vol. 11 No. 2, April-July 2026, pp. 1204-1212</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/thai2026-matcha-powder-thailand-metals">Read source →</a></span></span></sup>

For a buyer the practical points are the form bought, the basis a result is reported on, where the matcha powder came from and the laboratory’s reporting limit. Testing finds contamination but does not remove it.

## What counts as matcha powder

<a id="hmi-ing-001"></a>
<a id="what-commodity-biological-species-edible-part-and-commercial-forms-does-this-page-cover"></a>
<a id="hmi-ing-002"></a>
<a id="which-processing-states-and-derivatives-are-distinct-materials-rather-than-synonyms"></a>
<a id="hmi-ing-003"></a>
<a id="what-evidence-can-be-transferred-between-those-materials-and-what-requires-a-separate-answer"></a>

This page covers matcha powder, powder or ground (385 results).<sup class="cite">[[sources/thai2026-matcha-powder-thailand-metals|1]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">ด้วยเศียรเกล้า รัสริณทร์, บำรุงพืชน์ เอกราช · 2026</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/thai2026-matcha-powder-thailand-metals">Determination of heavy metal contents in commercial matcha powder sold in Thailand (Thai: ปริมาณสารโลหะหนักตกค้างในผลิตภัณฑ์ผงมัทฉะที่จำหน่ายในประเทศไทย)</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Journal of Environmental Education Medical and Health (Thailand), Vol. 11 No. 2, April-July 2026, pp. 1204-1212</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/thai2026-matcha-powder-thailand-metals">Read source →</a></span></span></sup><sup class="cite">[[sources/kolackova2020-matcha-minerals-trace-elements|2]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Koláčková T, Sumczynski D, Zálešáková L, Šenkárová L, Orsavová J, Lanczová N · 2020</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/kolackova2020-matcha-minerals-trace-elements">Free and bound amino acids, minerals and trace elements in matcha (Camellia sinensis L.): A nutritional evaluation</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Journal of Food Composition and Analysis (2020), article 103581 (Journal Pre-proof)</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/kolackova2020-matcha-minerals-trace-elements">Read source →</a></span></span></sup>

Results stay on the basis each source reports: as sold or fresh weight, dry weight, or unstated. Dry-weight, as-sold and unstated results are never pooled, and no moisture conversion is applied.

<a id="heavy-metal-contamination-profile"></a>
## Heavy metal contamination profile of matcha powder

<a id="hmi-ing-007"></a>
<a id="which-metals-and-chemical-species-have-been-investigated-in-this-ingredient"></a>
<a id="hmi-ing-008"></a>
<a id="what-concentrations-detection-frequencies-and-variability-were-observed-in-each-defined-sampling-frame"></a>
<a id="hmi-ing-009"></a>
<a id="which-analyte-questions-are-unassessed-access-blocked-conflicting-or-searched-without-eligible-evidence"></a>

The table holds every extracted matcha powder result: one row for each statistic a source reports for a form, group and metal, 385 rows in all, grouped by metal and form; percentiles, ranges and maxima for the same samples as a mean or median are shown on that row.<sup class="cite">[[sources/thai2026-matcha-powder-thailand-metals|1]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">ด้วยเศียรเกล้า รัสริณทร์, บำรุงพืชน์ เอกราช · 2026</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/thai2026-matcha-powder-thailand-metals">Determination of heavy metal contents in commercial matcha powder sold in Thailand (Thai: ปริมาณสารโลหะหนักตกค้างในผลิตภัณฑ์ผงมัทฉะที่จำหน่ายในประเทศไทย)</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Journal of Environmental Education Medical and Health (Thailand), Vol. 11 No. 2, April-July 2026, pp. 1204-1212</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/thai2026-matcha-powder-thailand-metals">Read source →</a></span></span></sup><sup class="cite">[[sources/kolackova2020-matcha-minerals-trace-elements|2]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Koláčková T, Sumczynski D, Zálešáková L, Šenkárová L, Orsavová J, Lanczová N · 2020</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/kolackova2020-matcha-minerals-trace-elements">Free and bound amino acids, minerals and trace elements in matcha (Camellia sinensis L.): A nutritional evaluation</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Journal of Food Composition and Analysis (2020), article 103581 (Journal Pre-proof)</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/kolackova2020-matcha-minerals-trace-elements">Read source →</a></span></span></sup> Monitoring medians are HMI calculations from individual submissions; non-detects remain intervals between zero and the reporting limit and are never read as zero.

65 rows can be rated against an HMI reference for the same form and basis, 286 rows have a direct same-study comparison, and the rest stay unrated with the reason recorded.

<div class="hmi-analyte-explorer" id="hmi-occurrence-matcha-powder" data-analyte-explorer data-compact-intro="true" data-source-summaries="true"><details class="hmi-drawer-disclosure" data-explorer-context><summary data-open-context aria-haspopup="dialog" aria-controls="hmi-occurrence-matcha-powder-drawer">Comparison methods and scope</summary><div data-explorer-context-content>

<p>Each row is one statistic a source reports for one form of matcha powder, group and metal; percentiles, ranges and maxima reported for the same samples as a mean or median are shown on that row. Different forms and preparation states are kept apart, and dry-weight results never share a reference with as-sold or fresh-weight results. Ratings place a result against an HMI reference built from monitoring results and ordinary-setting medians for the same form and basis. Same-study contrasts compare a contaminated or treated site with its control, targeted with random sampling, a prepared form with the unprocessed one, or one group of a study with the median of its other groups. Held rows failed a check against their own source and are shown but not compared.</p>

dataset methods and interpretation</summary><div data-shared-evidence-content><p>Source summaries retain their original statistic, material, basis and censoring. Each source drawer identifies methods and overlapping samples. No matched reference or pooled distribution is inferred.</p></div></details><details class="hmi-drawer-disclosure" data-baseline-fallback id="hmi-reference-hmi-pooled-reference-v2:matcha-powder-7f18475e6dc8:27fab1a834cf"><summary>HMI matcha powder Pb reference · Matcha powder, powder or ground</summary><div data-baseline-reference-template="hmi-pooled-reference-v2:matcha-powder-7f18475e6dc8:27fab1a834cf"><p class="hmi-drawer-section-title" role="heading" aria-level="3">Reference and scope</p><p>HMI matcha powder Pb reference · Matcha powder, powder or ground. Matcha powder, powder or ground; As sold, as eaten or fresh weight, µg/kg; no moisture conversion. Distribution of subgroup median concentration values.</p><div class="hmi-drawer-table"><table><thead><tr><th scope="col">Reference (µg/kg)</th><th scope="col">Q1</th><th scope="col">Median</th><th scope="col">Q3</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>Primary HMI reference</td><td>246</td><td>291</td><td>518</td></tr><tr><td>Alternative weighting</td><td>246</td><td>291</td><td>518</td></tr></tbody></table></div><p>12 reference units; 1 sampling family. Counts describe evidence units, not independent studies or certainty.</p><div class="hmi-drawer-table"><table><thead><tr><th scope="col">Contributing family</th><th scope="col">Reference units</th><th scope="col">Weight</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>รัสริณทร์ et al. 2026</td><td>12</td><td>100%</td></tr></tbody></table></div><p class="hmi-drawer-section-title" role="heading" aria-level="3">Methods</p><p>HMI pools subgroup medians for matcha powder, powder or ground on a as sold, as eaten or fresh weight basis: monitoring results summarized as one median per reporting region, sampling type and collection year, total diet composites and printed sample values as single observations, and printed subgroup medians from ordinary farms or markets. Each sampling family has equal total weight. Non-detects stay as zero-to-limit intervals, so quartiles carry lower and upper bounds. Means, ranges and maxima never enter as observations. Other forms, other bases, targeted sampling and results from mining, industrial, wastewater-affected, experimental, fertiliser or manufacturer settings are kept out of this reference.</p><p>Inverse weighted empirical CDF; midpoint at exact cumulative-weight boundaries. At least four reference units and a definitely positive Q1 to Q3 spread are required. This is a display eligibility rule, not statistical validation.</p><p class="hmi-drawer-section-title" role="heading" aria-level="3">Limitations</p><p>รัสริณทร์ et al. 2026 is the only compatible sampling family for matcha powder, powder or ground on this basis in the completed matcha powder ledger, so this single-family reference cannot represent other markets. Reporting regions and purchase markets are not growing areas. Non-detects with differing limits widen the bounds. A position is descriptive concentration, not a safety or compliance judgment.</p><p class="hmi-drawer-section-title" role="heading" aria-level="3">Admitted source families</p><ul><li><a href="../sources/thai2026-matcha-powder-thailand-metals" class="internal" data-slug="sources/thai2026-matcha-powder-thailand-metals" data-no-cite-meta>รัสริณทร์ et al. 2026</a></li></ul><details class="hmi-drawer-disclosure"><summary>Reference version and interpretation</summary><p>Frozen evidence selection: 2026-10-22. Method: hmi-pooled-reference-v2.</p><p>hmi-pooled-reference-v2:matcha-powder-7f18475e6dc8:27fab1a834cf</p><p>The reference is computed by HMI from admitted evidence, not copied from a study baseline. It describes the evidence currently in this scope; it is not a worldwide or current-lot benchmark. Source, year and region filters do not change it. Counts describe evidence units, not independent studies or certainty.</p><div class="hmi-drawer-table"><table><thead><tr><th scope="col">Contributing family</th><th scope="col">Reference units</th><th scope="col">Weight</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>Koláčková et al. 2020</td><td>10</td><td>100%</td></tr></tbody></table></div><p class="hmi-drawer-section-title" role="heading" aria-level="3">Methods</p><p>HMI pools subgroup medians for matcha powder, powder or ground on a dry weight basis: monitoring results summarized as one median per reporting region, sampling type and collection year, total diet composites and printed sample values as single observations, and printed subgroup medians from ordinary farms or markets. Each sampling family has equal total weight. Non-detects stay as zero-to-limit intervals, so quartiles carry lower and upper bounds. Means, ranges and maxima never enter as observations. Other forms, other bases, targeted sampling and results from mining, industrial, wastewater-affected, experimental, fertiliser or manufacturer settings are kept out of this reference.</p><p>Inverse weighted empirical CDF; midpoint at exact cumulative-weight boundaries. At least four reference units and a definitely positive Q1 to Q3 spread are required. This is a display eligibility rule, not statistical validation.</p><p class="hmi-drawer-section-title" role="heading" aria-level="3">Limitations</p><p>Koláčková et al. 2020 is the only compatible sampling family for matcha powder, powder or ground on this basis in the completed matcha powder ledger, so this single-family reference cannot represent other markets. Reporting regions and purchase markets are not growing areas. Non-detects with differing limits widen the bounds. A position is descriptive concentration, not a safety or compliance judgment.</p><p class="hmi-drawer-section-title" role="heading" aria-level="3">Admitted source families</p><ul><li><a href="../sources/kolackova2020-matcha-minerals-trace-elements" class="internal" data-slug="sources/kolackova2020-matcha-minerals-trace-elements" data-no-cite-meta>Koláčková et al. 2020</a></li></ul><details class="hmi-drawer-disclosure"><summary>Reference version and interpretation</summary><p>Frozen evidence selection: 2026-10-22. Method: hmi-pooled-reference-v2.</p><p>hmi-pooled-reference-v2:matcha-powder-cdddc9821adf:0929621f5cf2</p><p>The reference is computed by HMI from admitted evidence, not copied from a study baseline. It describes the evidence currently in this scope; it is not a worldwide or current-lot benchmark. Source, year and region filters do not change it. Different HMI scopes are not one common ranking.</p></details></div></details><div hidden data-form-reasons><p data-reason="bounds_span_categories" data-title="Non-detect spans the bands">The result is below a reporting limit, and the range from zero to that limit crosses more than one band.</p></div><script type="application/octet-stream" data-explorer-payload data-encoding="base64"></script><div hidden data-explorer-details data-chunk-rows="100"><div hidden data-explorer-chunk="0"><script type="application/octet-stream" data-encoding="base64"></script><div data-evidence-content><p class="hmi-dataset-title"><a href="../sources/thai2026-matcha-powder-thailand-metals" class="internal" data-slug="sources/thai2026-matcha-powder-thailand-metals">รัสริณทร์ et al. 2026</a></p><p>Matcha powder, powder or ground · Lead (Pb) · 12 samples.</p><p class="hmi-drawer-section-title" role="heading" aria-level="3">Selected finding and reference</p><div class="hmi-selected-result" data-selected-finding><strong class="hmi-finding">404 µg/kg (mean ± 267 SD)</strong><span class="hmi-row-note">mean.</span><p>12 samples. <a id="what-effects-on-nutrition-yield-sensory-quality-stability-and-waste-streams-were-measured"></a>
<a id="hmi-ing-024"></a>
<a id="what-costs-constraints-adverse-effects-or-failure-modes-are-documented-and-which-are-unknown"></a>

Metals do not move together, so a lot that passes a lead limit says little about cadmium, arsenic or nickel unless those are tested as well.



<a id="sampling-and-testing"></a>
## Testing matcha powder for metals

<a id="hmi-ing-025"></a>
<a id="what-sampling-design-is-appropriate-for-the-ingredient-heterogeneity-lot-and-decision"></a>
<a id="hmi-ing-026"></a>

<a id="hmi-ing-027"></a>
<a id="what-can-a-certificate-of-analysis-or-non-detect-establish-and-what-remains-untested"></a>

Results depend on the method and its reporting limit. Reporting limits for lead were 0.01 µg/kg where sources stated them.<sup class="cite">[[sources/kolackova2020-matcha-minerals-trace-elements|2]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Koláčková T, Sumczynski D, Zálešáková L, Šenkárová L, Orsavová J, Lanczová N · 2020</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/kolackova2020-matcha-minerals-trace-elements">Free and bound amino acids, minerals and trace elements in matcha (Camellia sinensis L.): A nutritional evaluation</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Journal of Food Composition and Analysis (2020), article 103581 (Journal Pre-proof)</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/kolackova2020-matcha-minerals-trace-elements">Read source →</a></span></span></sup>

A useful lot result names the form, the basis and a quantification limit well below the limit that applies.

No maximum level for metals in matcha powder was verified from primary text for this page; buyers should confirm the limit that applies in the destination market.

<a id="universal-faqs"></a>
## Matcha powder FAQs

<details class="qa" data-hmi-faq="1" id="what-heavy-metals-are-found-in-matcha-powder" data-anchor="what-heavy-metals-are-found-in-matcha-powder" data-question="What heavy metals are found in matcha powder?">
<summary><span class="mk" aria-hidden="true"></span>What heavy metals are found in matcha powder?</summary>
<div class="ans" data-hmi-faq-answer="1">

The library reports lead, cadmium, total arsenic, total mercury, nickel, chromium, aluminium, tin, uranium, Co, Cu, Fe, Mn, Zn, Se, Ag, Ba, Be, Ca, Ce, Cs, Ga, Ho, K, Li, Mg, Na, P, Sr, Ta, Ti and Tl in matcha powder, most often lead, cadmium and total arsenic.<sup class="cite">[[sources/thai2026-matcha-powder-thailand-metals|1]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">ด้วยเศียรเกล้า รัสริณทร์, บำรุงพืชน์ เอกราช · 2026</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/thai2026-matcha-powder-thailand-metals">Determination of heavy metal contents in commercial matcha powder sold in Thailand (Thai: ปริมาณสารโลหะหนักตกค้างในผลิตภัณฑ์ผงมัทฉะที่จำหน่ายในประเทศไทย)</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Journal of Environmental Education Medical and Health (Thailand), Vol. 11 No. 2, April-July 2026, pp. 1204-1212</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/thai2026-matcha-powder-thailand-metals">Read source →</a></span></span></sup><sup class="cite">[[sources/kolackova2020-matcha-minerals-trace-elements|2]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Koláčková T, Sumczynski D, Zálešáková L, Šenkárová L, Orsavová J, Lanczová N · 2020</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/kolackova2020-matcha-minerals-trace-elements">Free and bound amino acids, minerals and trace elements in matcha (Camellia sinensis L.): A nutritional evaluation</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Journal of Food Composition and Analysis (2020), article 103581 (Journal Pre-proof)</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/kolackova2020-matcha-minerals-trace-elements">Read source →</a></span></span></sup>

</div>
</details>

<details class="qa" data-hmi-faq="1" id="which-origins-or-products-of-matcha-powder-measured-lowest" data-anchor="which-origins-or-products-of-matcha-powder-measured-lowest" data-question="Which origins or products of matcha powder measured lowest?">
<summary><span class="mk" aria-hidden="true"></span>Which origins or products of matcha powder measured lowest?</summary>
<div class="ans" data-hmi-faq-answer="1">

In one study, lead across 12 groups of matcha powder ranged from 184 µg/kg (retail product 08, origin Japan, Premium grade) to 1,040 µg/kg (retail product 07, origin Thailand, Culinary grade); the lowest is the lowest observed in that study, not an established sourcing preference.<sup class="cite">[[sources/thai2026-matcha-powder-thailand-metals|1]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">ด้วยเศียรเกล้า รัสริณทร์, บำรุงพืชน์ เอกราช · 2026</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/thai2026-matcha-powder-thailand-metals">Determination of heavy metal contents in commercial matcha powder sold in Thailand (Thai: ปริมาณสารโลหะหนักตกค้างในผลิตภัณฑ์ผงมัทฉะที่จำหน่ายในประเทศไทย)</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Journal of Environmental Education Medical and Health (Thailand), Vol. 11 No. 2, April-July 2026, pp. 1204-1212</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/thai2026-matcha-powder-thailand-metals">Read source →</a></span></span></sup> In another study, lead across 6 groups of matcha powder ranged from 0.05 µg/kg (retail product 4) to 1.82 µg/kg (retail product 1); the lowest is the lowest observed in that study, not an established sourcing preference.<sup class="cite">[[sources/kolackova2020-matcha-minerals-trace-elements|2]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Koláčková T, Sumczynski D, Zálešáková L, Šenkárová L, Orsavová J, Lanczová N · 2020</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/kolackova2020-matcha-minerals-trace-elements">Free and bound amino acids, minerals and trace elements in matcha (Camellia sinensis L.): A nutritional evaluation</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Journal of Food Composition and Analysis (2020), article 103581 (Journal Pre-proof)</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/kolackova2020-matcha-minerals-trace-elements">Read source →</a></span></span></sup>

</div>
</details>
